other_download.title: Introductory paper (LREC-16)
other_download.description: The paper where we introduced PreMOn (predicate model for ontologies), a linguistic resource for exposing predicate models (PropBank, NomBank, VerbNet, and FrameNet) and mappings between them (e.g, SemLink, PredicateMatrix) as Linked Open Data.
